Title: Model Reviews Feature
Summary: Feature module for displaying LLM model reviews used with Cyréna. Includes a standalone page component, service with static data, model interface, and route registration.
Content: ## Model Reviews Feature Location: `src/app/features/model-reviews/` ### ModelReview Interface `src/app/features/model-reviews/models/model-reviewmodel.model.ts` ```ts export interface ModelReview { category: 'Offline' | 'Cloud'; model: string; provider: string; size?: string; bestUseCases: string[]; thinkingMode: string; strengths: string[]; weaknesses: string[]; rating: number; detailedReview: string; proTip?: string; } ``` ### ModelReviewsServiceService `src/app/features/model-reviews/services/model-reviews-service.service.ts` - `providedIn: 'root'` - Holds a private static array of 9 `ModelReview` entries covering offline and cloud LLMs. - Public methods: - `getReviews(): ModelReview[]` — all reviews - `getOfflineReviews(): ModelReview[]` — category === 'Offline' - `getCloudReviews(): ModelReview[]` — category === 'Cloud' ### ModelReviewsPageComponent `src/app/features/model-reviews/components/model-reviews-page/model-reviews-page.component.ts` - Standalone component, `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` - Injects `ModelReviewsServiceService` via `inject()` - Signals: - `offlineReviews` — from service - `cloudReviews` — from service - `selectedCategory` — string, default `'All'` - `filteredReviews` — computed based on selected category - Method: `setCategory(category: string): void` - TrackBy: `trackByModel(index, review) => review.model` ### Route Registered lazily in `app.routes.ts`: ```ts { path: 'model-reviews', loadComponent: () => import('./features/model-reviews/components/model-reviews-page/model-reviews-page.component').then(m => m.ModelReviewsPageComponent) } ``` ### Navigation Added to `app.component.html` navbar as: ```html Model Reviews ``` ### Template Highlights - Category filter buttons (All / Offline / Cloud) - Cards per review with badge, star rating, best use cases, thinking mode, strengths/weaknesses lists, detailed review paragraph, optional pro-tip alert - General tips section at bottom
